name: LXD API
description: LXD's free API plan includes five Xen per day for text models.
overview: LXD API's Arabic-language pricing page advertises a $0 daily plan with 5 Xen every day, access to all text models and 5 images per day. It provides an OpenAI SDK-compatible interface with models including GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek V4 Flash. Xen is the platform's own consumption unit; its conversion to model tokens is not specified on the plan page, so the daily token capacity cannot be inferred.
free_access: 5 Xen per day on the free plan
All text models included in the plan
notes: Card requirements for signup were not confirmed. The page does not specify how many tokens 5 Xen buys; model availability and quota can change.
